name: FreshRSS
description: FreshRSS is a lightweight RSS and Atom feed aggregator. Self-host it on your own server with Panara Cloud, which deploys FreshRSS as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Lightweight RSS and Atom feed reader. Deploy FreshRSS with Docker Compose on Panara Cloud in minutes – free, open source, self-hosted.
